decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 6 December 2002, the operation of a chauffeur business using part of the living room in the dwellinghouse at 23 Holly House as an office for a husband and wife single car chauffeur business with no pick ups or drop offs from the said address is lawful within the meaning of section 191 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) for the following reasons;

The proposed development would fall within Section 191 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended). Planning permission is therefore not required.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the use of maisonette to take telephone bookings for chauffeur business using part of living room in the dwellinghouse at 23 Holly House as an office for a husband and wife single car chauffeur business with no pick ups or drop offs from the said address.
